content.summary: Research findings for Claude Agent SDK V2 MCP server configuration and why in-process MCP tools are missing.

data.original_input: Research: Claude Agent SDK V2 MCP Server Configuration. OpenCode MCP tools are missing in V2; investigate unstable_v2_createSession/mcpServers handling and recommend a fix.

codebase_findings.detail: SDKSessionOptions for V2 includes model/path/env/allowedTools/disallowedTools/permissionMode but no mcpServers (see SDKSessionOptions definition).
V2 session constructor initializes internal query with mcpServers: {} and strictMcpConfig: false, indicating V2 does not wire MCP servers into the session (minified U9 constructor).
V1 Options for query include mcpServers?: Record<string, McpServerConfig>; McpServerConfig supports stdio/sse/http and in-process SDK servers (McpSdkServerConfigWithInstance).
Query interface exposes setMcpServers(), which supports SDK (in-process) servers and process-based servers; this is the supported dynamic MCP API.
OpenCode passes mcpServers and allowedTools into unstable_v2_createSession, but the V2 SDK ignores mcpServers (not in SDKSessionOptions).
createSdkMcpServer returns a McpSdkServerConfigWithInstance (type: 'sdk', name, instance) which is intended for Query.setMcpServers or Options.mcpServers in V1.

prior_art: No prior explore/learn packets found in .agents/messages.
patterns: V2 session API is a minimal wrapper over a CLI process and does not accept MCP server configs; MCP config is only supported in the V1 query API.
In-process MCP servers are supported by the SDK only through McpSdkServerConfigWithInstance and Query.setMcpServers (V1).
Passing mcpServers into unstable_v2_createSession has no effect; MCP servers must be configured via V1 APIs or external CLI configuration.
raw_options: Use V1 query() API with options.mcpServers or Query.setMcpServers to register the in-process OpenCode MCP server.
Adapt current V2 session wrapper to build on query() and feed a message stream to emulate sessions while using setMcpServers.
Keep V2 but move MCP server to an external process (stdio/http/sse) and configure it via Claude Code settings, not in-process.
Fork/patch claude-agent-sdk to add mcpServers to SDKSessionOptions and wire through to the internal Query/setMcpServers path.
Create a local plugin that registers MCP servers at startup via settings, then keep V2 unchanged.
Switch to a V1-compatible integration path for tool calling while keeping V2 for model messaging (hybrid).
